recruiterCard.summary: Prototyped the front end of a recipe app: list what is in the fridge, browse suggested recipes with nutrition facts, and cook along with step timers. The prototype runs on sample recipes and has no back end.
impactBullets: Built the ingredient entry, recipe results, recipe detail and cook-mode screens in React and TypeScript.
Showed nutrition facts on each recipe and added per-step timers to the cook mode.
Used sample recipe data so the whole flow, from ingredients to a cooked meal, could be tried end to end.
